newsitem.title: USA: Galaxy Foods says returns to profitability.
newsitem.headline: Galaxy Foods says returns to profitability.

text.p: Galaxy Foods Co said Tuesday it returned to profitability in its fiscal first quarter ended June 30 and expects to report record sales of $5.8 million for the period.
First quarter results will be released on July 22, during market hours, the company said.
Galaxy expects revenues for the first 14 weeks of its fiscal year to give it an annual sales rate of $24 million, up 40 percent from actual sales of $17.1 in its fiscal year ended March 31.
"The past few years have been a rebuilding process for Galaxy since its tragic fire in 1991, and I am happy to report we have returned to profitability," said President Angelo Morini.
Galaxy said sales of higher-margin retail supermarket and health food products represented 62 percent of sales for the first quarter.
It said its focus remains on increasing these higher-margin retail sales and continuing the introduction of new products into the retail and food service markets.
Galaxy Foods produces low-fat, low- and no-cholesterol cheese and dairy-related products.
